title: Internal HumanAIOS Agent — The Witness — resource planning specimen

needs.label: Epistemically-aware human/system interaction
needs.statement: Reduce the burden of understanding and acting on HumanAIOS state while preserving human agency, evidence visibility, uncertainty, revocation, and authority boundaries.

capabilities.label: Bounded orientation
capabilities.description: Present relevant system state, capabilities, limitations, unknowns, and evidence without presenting synthesis as canonical fact.

capabilities.label: Evidence-bearing projection
capabilities.description: Project relevant canonical resources through an observation-bounded context while preserving provenance and omission states.

capabilities.label: Authority transparency
capabilities.description: Expose warrant, authorization, consent, interruption, and revocation state without creating authority.

capabilities.label: Reconstructable explanation
capabilities.description: Emit provenance-bearing receipts sufficient to reconstruct what evidence and constraints were available to the Witness.

capabilities.label: Validated service effect
capabilities.description: Demonstrate that the Witness reduces comprehension burden without covertly increasing system authority or compliance pressure.

controlled_resources.label: Existing HumanAIOS evidence, warrant, authorization, provenance, and Witness design primitives
restrictions: repository primitives are not a deployed Witness runtime

controlled_resources.label: Existing AI analysis, coding, and review capacity
restrictions: not a substitute for paid human knowledge-set expertise where that is the requirement

controlled_resources.label: Acquired Microsoft startup cloud credit resource

resource_requirements.label: Bounded model/runtime compute
resource_requirements.objective: Provide model inference and runtime compute sufficient for a bounded Witness prototype.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: A bounded Witness workload runs with measured capacity, cost, latency, and availability.

resource_requirements.label: Evidence/provenance graph access
resource_requirements.objective: Provide typed read access to provenance-bearing evidence, omissions, and canonical source references.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: The Witness can reconstruct a bounded projection from source receipts without inventing missing evidence.

resource_requirements.label: Warrant/authorization/consent state
resource_requirements.objective: Expose current authority and consent boundaries to the Witness without allowing the Witness to self-authorize.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Authority state is inspectable and provenance-bound, and no Witness operation can increase its own authority.

resource_requirements.label: Isolation and permission enforcement
resource_requirements.objective: Enforce bounded data access, permission scope, interruption, and revocation for the Witness runtime.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Mechanical controls prevent unauthorized observation or action and produce an auditable receipt.

resource_requirements.label: Independent human validation
resource_requirements.objective: Acquire independent human methodological, usability, governance, and adversarial evaluation of the bounded Witness prototype.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: At least one sufficiently independent human reviewer or study produces a provenance-bearing evaluation against preregistered criteria.

resource_requirements.label: Paid human knowledge-set expertise
resource_requirements.objective: Acquire paid human research, engineering, human-factors, governance, or security expertise needed to implement and test the Witness where AI/self-labor is not an adequate substitute.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Qualified human effort is available under a bounded scope, compensation basis, and deliverable receipt.

resource_requirements.label: Dedicated local/edge compute
resource_requirements.objective: Acquire local CPU/GPU only if a Witness experiment proves that cloud/API compute is an inadequate substitute.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: A measured local/edge workload requirement is met without unnecessary duplicate infrastructure.

resource_requirements.label: Physical actuation/sensing platform
resource_requirements.objective: Acquire sensors, edge devices, or robotics only if a later Witness experiment requires physical observation or actuation that simulation cannot validate.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: A preregistered physical-control experiment has the minimum platform needed to observe authority, interruption, rollback, and consequence.

substitution_assessments.rationale: Azure is an acquired compute resource, but no bounded Witness workload/cost/latency benchmark has established adequacy.
Evidence and provenance primitives exist, but no admitted Witness projection runtime currently binds them into this capability.
Warrant/authorization concepts exist, but the Witness-specific mechanical read boundary has not been demonstrated.
Repository governance boundaries exist; a Witness runtime sandbox/permission path has not been demonstrated.
AI/internal review cannot establish independent human validation.
AI capacity can reduce implementation effort but cannot substitute for a requirement explicitly scoped to paid human knowledge-set expertise.
